decision.reason: inputs/release.json records six passing keyless Tier 1 checks for the installed package, with 33 advisory warnings, and native OMP catalogue readback. This establishes package QC and discovery, not task improvement. In inputs/old-study.json, all four OMP arms used the same tools, produced all artifacts, and scored 8/8 blind on one trial handoff. That tie applies only to that task and the earlier pre-rename package. Neither file contains a matched trial for the installed revision, so its benefit remains unassessed and fleet behavior evidence is insufficient.
